Fantastic Indian in HCMC
Sep 2019 • Solo
8:00 pm evening search for dinner.I had wandered around the neighbourhood and came across Ashoka by chance. It wasn’t full it had several tables of Indian gentlemen feasting.
To me, that is a very good sign.I am traveling by myself so couldn’t order much.The Lamb Rohan Josh melted in your mouth with a perfect sauce. Vegetable Biryani, perfectly cooked with a very good variety of veg that were cooked with a firmness, not raw but not overdone. The garlic naan was not overly heavy on the garlic but piqued your tongue with every bite. The staff was attentive without being pushy and they were genuinely pleased that I enjoyed the meal. With a Saigon Special Beer, the total bill was 421,000d or about US$17.50.
Excellent value for an excellent meal.

Good food, comfortable setting
Feb 2019 • Business
My colleague & I came across this restaurant as we were walking around our hotel looking for a decent place for dinner. We ordered garlic naan with fish masala and another fish dish with cheese (I forgot the name of this dish). We also had mango lassi. I’m very happy to report that both fish dishes we ordered were very tasty as were the mango lassi. I can’t comment on the price as I don’t have anything to compare against, but just to give an idea of the price, our total bill was VND580,000.
So if you’re hankering for good Indian food, I think you won’t be disappointed with this one.
